notes: Secrets come from the encrypted secret file: the client must start the entry with TOOLPORT_SECRET_KEY in its environment (it is never written to the client config).
data.tradeoff: A direct entry bypasses the Toolport gateway: its tools are not covered by profile tool scopes, approvals (HITL), receipts or lazy discovery, and every client with a direct entry starts its own process of the server instead of sharing one.
